# Webflow University

> > Comprehensive learning platform for mastering web design, development, and optimization using Webflow's no-code website builder.

Webflow University is the official educational hub for learning Webflow, offering structured courses, interactive tutorials, certifications, and enterprise training. The platform covers everything from design fundamentals and CSS/Flexbox to advanced features like CMS, animations, and AI-powered optimization tools.

## Key Topics

- Webflow
- No-code design
- Web design basics
- CSS Grid
- Flexbox
- Interactions & animations
- CMS & dynamic content
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
- Webflow Practitioner certification
- Learning paths
- Interactive tutorials
- Site optimization
- Webflow Enterprise
- Design systems
- Webflow Ecommerce

## Getting Started

- [Webflow University](https://university.webflow.com): Webflow University homepage: learn design, build, and launch websites
- [Getting started with Webflow](https://university.webflow.com/courses/getting-started-with-webflow): Beginner guide to Webflow's website experience platform
- [Design basics](https://university.webflow.com/courses/design-basics): Learning path for web design fundamentals and content optimization
- [Interactive learning](https://university.webflow.com/interactive-learning): Interactive tutorials for CSS Grid, Flexbox, and web design fundamentals

## Learning Paths & Courses

- [Webflow design basics learning path](https://university.webflow.com/learning-paths/webflow-design-basics): Structured learning path for professional Webflow site design
- [Interactions & animations](https://university.webflow.com/courses/interactions-animations): Tutorial on creating motion and interactions for user experience
- [AEO from Webflow](https://university.webflow.com/courses/aeo-from-webflow): Course on AI-driven search engine optimization and answer engines

## Certifications & Professional Development

- [Webflow University Certifications](https://university.webflow.com/certifications): Webflow Practitioner certification program for professional credibility
- [Webflow University Pro](https://university.webflow.com/pro-overview): Enterprise training with live instructors and hands-on workshops

## User Dashboard

- [Dashboard](https://university.webflow.com/dashboard): User dashboard for course enrollment, progress tracking, and certifications
